u0: No switch flip has happened yet and the siren has not yet rung. Nothing is required unless the siren starts ringing, but flipping the switch now would already satisfy the conditional requirement in advance. Until either event happens, the requirement imposes no further obligation.
u1: The switch has been flipped at least once, whether before or after any siren. The conditional requirement is therefore permanently satisfied, even if the siren rings later. No further switch flips are needed for this requirement, and the task remains on this satisfied condition.
u2: The siren has rung while no switch flip has occurred, so the conditional requirement is now active and unmet. You must flip the switch at least once to satisfy it; until then the obligation remains pending and ending without a flip would leave it unfulfilled. The siren stays on until the switch is flipped.
